# E-M5 III 1.7 Color / Monochrome Profile with an on-camera wheel editor

Test builds make the hidden Color and Monochrome Profile modes selectable and editable on the camera; edits show in live view and photos.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished test builds (2026-11-19 to 2026-11-20)

Color Profile and Monochrome Profile (three slots each) are entries in the Picture Mode carousel; INFO opens an editor with the colour or mono wheel (the E-M1 III 1.6 wheel routines, relocated) and a side bar with dial-set rows; colour (12 hue sectors) and mono (filter, level) edits apply to live view and photos, and per-slot sharpness and contrast are set from the Super Control Panel.

**Availability:** experimental branch. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M5 III 1.7: Color / Monochrome Profile editor on the camera](../evidence/em5-iii-profile-editor-camera.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.

## Limits

- Test builds only; none is published.
- The firmware already holds the profile settings and processing; the builds add selection and the editor.
- Restoring the hidden slots follows the Caduceus OM-5 II port; card-loaded looks are not built yet.
- The wheel pictures come from the PEN-F, because the E-M1 III does not ship them.
